name: dsh-dialog-watcher
description: Windows blocking-dialog watcher for DSH. Resident probe (PowerShell + C#, Win32 EnumWindows + UIA), session-command ledger, window->session attribution with strong/medium/weak levels and a two-command/two-dialog confirmation state machine, steer-based injection under source kind plugin:dialog-watcher, model-driven dialog_action clicker (UIA Invoke then Win32 BM_CLICK, never activates the window or steals focus), and a web UI toggle panel anchored under the dtt-bar. Probe and click default to ON; disabling the probe disables clicking and stops the probe process with zero residue.
